restaurants.notes: Source pages read in full via curl: /danville, /menu-danville, /our-story, /catering-danville, /contact-us-danville, /order-online-danville, /danville-1, /lafayette, /home, /menu-lafayette, /bonus-card, /reservations-danville, plus sitemap.xml. Squarespace site. All URLs below returned HTTP 200 on curl -sIL AND on a full GET; width/height were read with Pillow from the actual downloaded bytes. IMPORTANT: the Squarespace CDN content-negotiates, so a modern Accept header gets content-type image/webp and the recorded content-length is the webp size, even though the source files are .jpg/.png; strip the ?format= param or use ?format=2500w as shown. The five /danville gallery photos (image00001, image00013, image00018, image00041, image00046) are the Danville-specific shoot (the exterior matches the tan-body / burnt-orange repaint Bay Area Telegraph described, and image00046 is the same building). The 'untitled shoot-####' files are shared brand photography used across both the Lafayette and Danville sub-sites - they are food/drink studio shots, not location-identifying. There is NO standalone logo image file on the site: the header wordmark is live text (Orpheus Pro), so logo_url points at the site favicon (a 300x300 bracket/horn ornament, the only raster brand mark served); the full 'RANCHO CANTINA' wordmark appears rendered inside the 4x6 promo card listed below. og_image is given exactly as the meta tag serves it (http + legacy static1 path); it 301-redirects to a 200 (218,564 bytes) - the canonical equivalent is the images.squarespace-cdn 'untitled+shoot-1526-Edit.jpg' entry below. EXCLUDED ON PURPOSE: https://bayareatelegraph.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/image-211.png (1260x945, HTTP 200) - I verified via the article that its caption is 'Rancho Cantina in Lafayette. Credit: Thomas Smith', i.e. the wrong location, so it is not listed as a Danville image. No Instagram/Facebook CDN URLs are included. Yelp/Google user photos were not needed. Hours, prices and dish names were not inferred from any image.

images.description: Golden-hour storefront of the Danville location: tan/cream clapboard facade with black serif 'RANCHO CANTINA' letters on the fascia, dark reclaimed-wood beam awning with hanging bulb lights and a black lantern, two tan patio umbrellas, wood-railed deck patio with orange-slat chairs and tables, and a burnt-orange stucco planter wall in front holding agaves, a cactus and a burgundy cordyline. Clear blue sky.

Main dining room: three framed desert paintings of saguaro cactus against orange/red sunset mesas hung on a white shiplap wall, a pale-teal upholstered banquette below them, light wood tables set with amber hobnail votives and folded red-orange napkins, cream-seat wood chairs, a suspended reclaimed wood-lath ceiling raft, exposed red brick pier at right, and honey-toned plank flooring.

Booth corner: a large black metal cut-out silhouette of a vaquero on horseback swinging a lariat mounted on a white vertical-plank wall, a hammered black dome pendant with a gold interior, pale-teal banquette, butcher-block table with amber hobnail votives and orange napkins, and a framed painting of a tequila bottle at right. Clean, well-lit, simple background.

Behind the bar: a copper draft-beer tower with a row of taps set into a reclaimed-wood bar back, hand-painted ceramic tequila decanters (blue-and-white talavera style plus one black) on the shelf above, bottles of tequila and mezcal, stacked amber hobnail rocks glasses and inverted stemware below, and a bartender's arm reaching up for a bottle. Warm textured plaster wall.

Four men (team/ownership, one in a black chef's coat) standing arm-in-arm on the sidewalk in front of the Danville restaurant on a bright day. The 'RANCHO CANTINA' fascia sign, wood-railed deck, black lamp posts, terracotta pots of cactus and grasses, burnt-orange planter walls and a brick-paver crosswalk are all visible.

Overhead flat lay on a burnished copper table: a black plate with a red-sauced enchilada finished in a tight crema drizzle; a cast-iron oval skillet on a wood board holding chimichurri-topped chicken, sliced steak, grilled shrimp and zucchini; a black plate of chile relleno with rice and beans; a clear margarita with a lime wedge; a glass of dark beer; and a small dish of cucumber and jalapeno garnish beside a blue-striped kitchen towel.

Overhead taco spread on copper: two black plates of street tacos - fish tacos with cabbage slaw and chipotle drizzle, and carnitas/carne asada tacos with onion and cilantro - each with orange rice and whole beans dusted with cotija, plus a stack of warm corn tortillas, lime wedges, a red hibiscus (jamaica) drink and a beer. This is the site-wide og:image (also served from the legacy static1 path).

Wide overhead table spread on copper: a cut quesadilla with guacamole and greens, a dark plate of shredded/machaca-style beef with orange rice, saucy beans and cheesy calabacitas, a cast-iron skillet of mixed grill on a wood board, a bowl of beans with cotija and tortillas, a glass of dark beer, a lime margarita and two chile-rimmed cocktails with cucumber and jalapeno, plus a blue-striped towel.

Single plated entree shot from above on dark polished wood: a matte black plate with sliced grilled steak under a green chimichurri, orange rice, whole pinto beans dusted with cotija, a shaved fennel and herb salad, and a folded stack of warm corn tortillas. Clean subject on a simple dark background.

Overhead close-up of the wood-fired mixed grill: a cast-iron oval skillet on a wood paddle board holding chimichurri-drizzled chicken, sliced steak, grilled shrimp and a charred poblano, with a chile-salt-rimmed drink garnished with cucumber, lime and jalapeno beside it on a copper table.

Overhead on a black lattice patio table: a stainless bowl of tortilla chips flanked by a black bowl of green tomatillo salsa and one of dark red salsa, a chopped salad topped with fanned avocado, radish, corn and shredded cheese, a chile-rimmed michelada-style drink with cucumber and jalapeno, and a magenta cocktail over ice.

Tight close-up of a layered purple-and-magenta cocktail in a black hobnail-textured tumbler, garnished with a bright orange wheel, against dark green foliage bokeh. Note: this file maxes out at 667x1000 even when 2500w is requested - too small for a full-bleed hero.

Wider overhead crop of the same copper-table spread as 'Copy of untitled shoot-1494', adding a plate of crema-drizzled enchiladas with rice and beans at lower left and a magenta cocktail at upper left. Maxes out at 1000x667.

Texture/detail shot used as a full-width section background on /danville and /our-story: split oak and hardwood logs burning with tall orange flames and smoke inside the wood-fired grill. Good for a wide banner strip; no signage or people.

Scan/artwork of the printed Danville menu, page 1 - khaki-beige stock with the bracket-framed 'RANCHO CANTINA' serif wordmark, gold-tan section headings (ANTOJITOS, WOOD FIRED), small crown ornaments and vintage line-art illustrations. Menu document, not a photograph.
Scan/artwork of the printed Danville menu, page 2 (drinks and margaritas side), same beige stock and serif treatment. Menu document, not a photograph.
5x7 Taco Tuesday menu/promo card artwork used on both the Danville and Lafayette menu pages. Graphic, not a photograph.
Image of the Danville expansion press release (single page, 'alchemy' letterhead, March 2026) posted on the /danville page. A document image, not a photograph - useful as a press-kit asset only.

Gift-card promo card artwork: the full white 'RANCHO CANTINA' serif wordmark with its bracket/horn ornament set over a darkened copper-table flat lay (enchilada, mixed-grill skillet, chile relleno, margarita). The only place on the site where the complete wordmark is rendered as a raster image - useful as a wordmark reference, though it is a promo composite, not a clean logo file.

Best corner-identifying exterior: the 501 Hartz Ave building photographed from the street at golden hour after the repaint - tan/cream body with a burnt-orange accented gable and orange base wall, dark wood pergola over the side deck, tan horizontal-slat patio fence, and two black 'RANCHO CANTINA DANVILLE - COMING SOON' banners on the gable and the fence. The green 'CHURCH ST' street-name sign and a stop sign are visible at the left, with the brick-paver crosswalk in the foreground, so the Hartz Ave / Church St corner is unambiguous.

The same 501 Hartz Ave corner building BEFORE the Rancho Cantina renovation, shot from the Church St sidewalk: sage-green clapboard with white trim, wood pergola over the porch, wood railing, brick base, black lamp posts and the '501' address numerals on the stucco wall at right, hills in the distance. Photo by Jeremy Walsh for Danville San Ramon. Useful as a 'before' image only - the building has since been repainted.

Interior of the 501 Hartz space as the former Cocina Hermanas (the room Rancho Cantina took over): red-brick piers and arches, a sculpted reclaimed wood-lath ceiling, red-and-cream striped banquettes along the windows, orange and white metal cafe chairs, dark plank floor. Article caption: 'The former Cocina Hermanas. Credit: Thomas Smith'. Pre-renovation - the finished Rancho Cantina room (see image00013) has teal banquettes and a lighter floor.

ARCHITECTURAL RENDERING, not a photograph: the planned Danville storefront with a terracotta stucco entry bay, a carved wood 'Rancho Cantina' sign under gooseneck lamps, tan stucco body, cream market umbrellas over patio tables, terracotta pots and a low terracotta planter wall. Article caption: 'Rendering of the new restaurant, credit Rancho Cantina.' Do not present as a photo of the built restaurant.

Wood-fired grill in action: split logs burning under a raised steel grate with food charring on the bars, flames and sparks, and a blue-and-yellow talavera-tiled surround at right. Article credit line is 'Credit: Rancho Cantina'; the caption does not state which of the two locations it was shot in.

Wide streetscape of the Hartz Ave / Church St corner from across the intersection, pre-renovation: the low corner restaurant building with its glassed porch and pergola, bare winter trees, planters and a low white wall, with 'Church St' painted on the pavement in the foreground. Flat lighting and the road-marking angle strongly suggest a street-level survey/Street-View-style capture rather than original photography - verify licensing before use. Served as image/jpeg despite the .webp filename.

Two margaritas in hand-blown green-rimmed glasses with chile-salt rims and burnt orange wheels, on a dark wood table with a yellow patio umbrella and greenery in soft bokeh behind. Runs in Diablo magazine's Diablo Dish column on Rancho Cantina's Danville opening; alt text on the page is 'ranchocantinamargaritas.png' (supplied/courtesy image).

restaurants.notes: Source pages read in full via curl: kaiasdanville.com/ (home), /gallery, /food-menu, /drink-menu, /party, /happy-hours-specials and the about page /danville-downtown-danville-kaia-s-island-kitchen-and-tiki-bar-about. SpotHopper-built site. Images are served two ways: (a) uploaded photos at https://static.spotapps.co/spots/<xx>/<hash>/<size> and (b) theme assets at https://static.spotapps.co/website_images/ab_websites/185099_website_v4/... . For the /spots/ files I compared size variants with curl -sIL: /medium ~45KB, /full ~211KB, /:original ~584KB - so ':original' is the largest and is what I list (note the literal colon in the path; 'original' without the colon 404s). I also normalised away the cdn.spotapps.co/spothopper/image/fetch/... resizing wrapper the homepage uses. Every URL below returned HTTP 200 with content-type image/jpeg (or image/png for the logo) on curl -sIL and on a full GET; width/height were read with Pillow from the downloaded bytes. Descriptions for the bar/mural/patio/exterior/lounge/fire-pit-table shots and for the poke bowl, fish tacos, tiki cocktail, mai tai and Aloha Feast are first-hand from inspecting the downloaded files. Descriptions for the remaining single-dish gallery shots are the restaurant's own alt-text captions from /gallery, quoted rather than guessed. The best facade image is about_us_page_1.jpg (straight-on, shows the '480' address and the carved sign). No Instagram/Facebook CDN URLs are included. A duplicate lower-resolution copy of the patio shot exists at savor_our_island/island_18.jpg (1200x900) and of the bar shot at island_11.jpg - I list the 2000px /spots/ versions instead where they duplicate.

images.description: Straight-on daylight facade of 480 Hartz Ave: pale-yellow board-and-batten wall with a cedar-shingle bay at left, a heavy timber post-and-beam awning carrying the address numerals '480', dark-green glass double doors etched with the Kaia's mark, a carved and stained wood sign reading 'KAIA'S / ISLAND KITCHEN & TIKIBAR', a painted 'ALOHA' tiki surfboard on the shingles, a wood host stand carved with sea turtles, a concrete bench on carved-tiki legs, and bird-of-paradise and grass plantings. Clean, well-lit, unobstructed - the strongest hero for identifying the building.

The tiki bar: a full-width thatched palapa roof over the bar with bamboo framing, black-and-white mudcloth-pattern drum pendant shades, blue/red/amber/green glass float balls hung in rope netting, carved tiki totems flanking the bar, a back bar washed in magenta and purple light and stacked with rum and spirits, wall-mounted screens playing reef and beach footage, a red-lit bar rail with mismatched vintage metal stools, and the painted sunset-beach mural continuing on the left wall.

Wide interior looking down the length of the room: bamboo ceiling framing and a painted-sky ceiling at left, woven lauhala and bamboo wall panels, high-tops with teal and orange stools, the hand-painted sunset-palms beach mural on the end wall, a thatched canopy and a tall carved tiki post at centre, and the working bar at right with copper mule mugs, shakers and a galvanized tub of glassware in the foreground.

The signature wall mural - a hand-painted sunset over a beach with palm trees, orange sky and a low sun on the water - behind a row of wood high-top tables with teal and orange stools, a carved wood wainscot band, woven wall panels, framed tropical art and tiki masks at left, a bamboo pendant with a printed shade, and a tall carved tiki totem in the right foreground. Site caption: 'Wall mural depicting a beach and palm trees.'

Sunlit garden patio: a grey steel pergola strung with festoon lights and hung with overhead heaters, teak-slat chairs and speckled granite-top tables on a concrete terrace, a cedar-shingle wall behind, raised concrete and redwood planters full of red mandevilla, bird-of-paradise and palms, and a few steps down to the street. Site caption: 'Outdoor dining area.'

Covered sidewalk patio running along Hartz Ave: a white soffit trimmed with split-bamboo poles, dark ceiling fans and infrared wall heaters, a bar-height rail counter along the street edge, speckled granite tables with red napkins and water glasses, a tall bamboo hedge screening the windows, and parked cars, street lamps and the tree-lined avenue beyond. Site caption: 'The exterior covered patio.'

The 'Kaia's Beach Hut' dining room: a freestanding bamboo-and-thatch hut structure built inside the room with a round carved sign reading 'Kaia's BEACH HUT', thatch eaves, a woven mat ceiling with Edison bulbs and a turquoise glass float, woven lauhala walls with carved wood panels and framed vintage beach prints, a surfboard on the wall, and mint-green metal cafe chairs at wood tables set with red napkins and candles. Site caption: 'A large dining hall.'

Tiki lounge nook: a large carved bamboo-framed relief panel of a turquoise island scene on the wall, a striped daybed sofa piled with coral and teal tropical-print pillows, a rattan armchair with a red hibiscus cushion, a surfboard-shaped coffee table on black hairpin legs, two rope-wrapped drum stools, a sisal rug, a small coral-shaded lamp and a galvanized ice bucket at left. Site caption: 'The lounge area with various decorations.'

The outdoor fire-pit table set with the full menu: a long teak table with a black lava-rock fire trough down the middle, ringed by dishes including loco moco with a fried egg, an ahi poke bowl with fanned avocado and edamame, a seared salmon plate, a Big Island cobb salad, a yellow curry with rice and an orchid, tuna crisps/tostadas with a dipping sauce, and a chocolate lava cake, plus a carved Kaia's tiki mug, a blue Hawaii in a hurricane glass and a mai tai. Site caption: 'Various food on the fire pit table.'

'Aloha Feast' - a wood table laid with nine plates against the red palm-print banquette: loco moco with a fried egg, an ahi poke bowl, a seared salmon over rice with a banana leaf, a black plate of tuna/ahi tostadas with a flower, salmon over black rice and slaw, a yellow shrimp curry with rice and an orchid, tuna crisps, and a chocolate dessert - plus a carved Kaia's tiki mug, a branded rocks glass with mint, a tall tiki-glyph glass and a blue Hawaii in a hurricane glass.

Ahi tuna poke bowl in a periwinkle-blue ceramic bowl on a wood table: cubed marinated ahi, a scoop of white rice with furikake on a banana leaf, edamame, pickled red onion, julienned carrot and cucumber, mango salsa and a fanned avocado, with a red palm-print banquette behind and a Kaia's-branded glass at right. Site caption: 'Ahi tuna poke bowl.'

Overhead of three fish tacos on a white plate over a banana leaf - white fish with pineapple salsa, purple cabbage, avocado and micro-greens - with three lime wedges and a mound of pineapple coleslaw, on a wood table beside a rattan chair. Site caption: 'Fish tacos, with pineapple salsa, cabbage, lime, avocado, and a side of pineapple coleslaw.'

Tall tiki highball printed with orange-and-black Polynesian glyphs, filled with crushed ice and a rose-coloured drink, garnished with a purple orchid and a long pandan/ti leaf, set on a yellow coaster on a wood table with the red-and-teal tropical-palm-print banquette filling the background. Site caption: 'Tiki cocktail.'

Mai tai in a rocks glass printed with the gold 'KAIA'S / ISLAND KITCHEN & TIKI BAR' logo and tiki glyphs, topped with crushed ice, a big mint bouquet and a lime wheel, on a wood table beside a woven rattan chair and a carved tiki side table with a turquoise planter. Site caption: 'Mai Tai cocktail with mint.' Branded glassware makes this a good logo-bearing detail shot.

The site's og:image: a crisp-skinned salmon fillet topped with micro-greens over white rice with broccolini, carrots and a banana-leaf garnish on a white plate, dotted with chilli oil and green herb powder, on a wood table with a red napkin, the red palm-print banquette behind and a carved orange tiki mug at upper right.

Elevated/drone still looking down Hartz Avenue in downtown Danville, used as the homepage video poster: brick-paver crosswalk and sidewalk bulb-outs, angled parking, a full sycamore canopy over the street, shop awnings and street lamps, and Kaia's blue monument sign and covered patio visible mid-frame on the right. Good neighbourhood/streetscape banner; it shows the block rather than the restaurant close-up.

Six women in flower leis, floral maxi dresses and a flower crown posed sitting and crouching on the concrete bench directly beneath the carved wood 'KAIA'S / ISLAND KITCHEN & TIKIBAR' sign on the yellow board-and-batten wall, framed by large bird-of-paradise leaves. Site caption: 'Several people posing outside in front of the restaurant.' Good for a 'celebrations/parties' slot; contains identifiable guests.
Restaurant's own gallery caption: 'Seafood with Thai green curry and rice.' Single-dish studio shot from the same in-house food shoot (wood table, tropical-print banquette background).
Restaurant's own gallery caption: 'Grilled salmon on a bed of rice, with sauteed veggies and oil.' Single-dish studio shot from the same in-house food shoot.
Restaurant's own gallery caption: 'Big Island Cobb Salad.' Single-dish studio shot from the same in-house food shoot.
Restaurant's own gallery caption: 'Loco Moco.' Single-dish studio shot from the same in-house food shoot.
Restaurant's own gallery caption: 'Vegetable Garlic Noodle.' Single-dish studio shot from the same in-house food shoot.
Restaurant's own gallery caption: 'Spam Musubi.' Single-dish studio shot from the same in-house food shoot.
Restaurant's own gallery caption: 'Poke Crisp.' Single-dish studio shot from the same in-house food shoot.
Restaurant's own gallery caption: 'Chocolate Lava Cake.' Dessert studio shot from the same in-house food shoot.

Primary logo file: the all-caps 'KAIA'S' wordmark in a heavy, slightly distressed dark-olive serif on a transparent PNG background. Small (262x57) - this is the only logo raster the site serves, so it will need vector re-creation for large-format use.

Highest-resolution exterior available: golden-hour view from the Hartz Ave sidewalk of the blue surfboard-shaped monument sign reading 'KAIA'S - ISLAND KITCHEN & TIKI BAR' in gold, set in a sand-and-river-rock garden with palms, succulents and red flowering plants, with the covered pergola patio full of diners, patio heaters and the cedar-shingle building behind, under big sycamores. Credit Thomas Smith / Bay Area Telegraph. Contains identifiable guests.

Kaia's from the Hartz Ave sidewalk on a bright day: the blue 'KAIA'S - ISLAND KITCHEN & TIKI BAR' monument sign in its sand-and-rock planting bed with palms and succulents, the grey steel pergola patio with heaters and umbrellas behind, a smaller 'KAIA'S' sign on the building, a US flag on the lamp post, brick-paver sidewalk and sycamore shade. Few people, clean framing.

Second exterior angle from the same review: the blue Kaia's monument sign closer and lower, showing the bronze sea-turtle sculpture and river-rock feature in the planting bed, with the pergola patio and seated guests behind and the residential street beyond. Credit Bay Area Telegraph. Contains identifiable guests.

A pale-gold frozen tropical drink (pina-colada / painkiller style) in a hurricane glass with a black straw and a pineapple wedge, sitting on the sidewalk-patio rail counter with Hartz Avenue, parked cars and a storefront awning in soft focus behind. Credit Bay Area Telegraph.

Detail shot of a round pulp-paper coaster on a speckled granite bar top, printed with the gold 'KAIA'S' wordmark, 'ISLAND KITCHEN & TIKI BAR' and a web address. Useful as a branded-detail image; note the coaster in this photo carries a misspelled URL ('kaiasdanvillle.com', three l's) so avoid using it anywhere the address must be legible. Credit Bay Area Telegraph.

Bright turquoise Blue Hawaii-style cocktail in a footed hurricane glass, capped with crushed ice and garnished with a pineapple wedge and a maraschino cherry, on a wood table against blurred palm foliage. Runs in Diablo magazine's Diablo Dish column; the page's alt text credits it 'Courtesy Kaia's'. CAUTION: the rendering of the glass, ice and foliage looks stylised/synthetic rather than like the rest of Kaia's photography - confirm provenance with the restaurant before publishing.

restaurants.notes: Source pages read in full via curl: danvilleharvest.com/ (home), /menu, /events, /contact, /reservations, plus sitemap.xml - those five are the entire site (there is no /about, /gallery or /private-events; all three return 404). Squarespace site. All URLs below returned HTTP 200 on curl -sIL and on a full GET; width/height were read with Pillow from the downloaded bytes. Same CDN caveat as Rancho Cantina: content-type comes back image/webp and the content-length is the webp size because the CDN negotiates, though the source files are .jpg/.png - request ?format=2500w as shown for the largest version. Every photo is from one shoot dated in the filenames as 6/15/23. Many carry the restaurant's own descriptive alt text, which I quote; where there was no alt text I described the file first-hand after downloading it. The Squarespace-generated stock filler on /menu (unsplash-image-xIFbDeGcy44.jpg) and the decorative vegetable cut-outs (tomatoes.png, lettuce.png, peppers.png, avo.png) were deliberately excluded as not being photographs of this restaurant, as were the sister-restaurant logos on the homepage footer (Los Gatos Parkside, Per Diem Financial District, Per Diem Transit Center). Two logo files exist: Danville_Harvest_conceptlogo.png (579x115) is the header logo and Harvest_yellow.png (350x201) is the stacked 'DANVILLE / barn+tree / harvest' mark - both are served as white/cream artwork on transparency, so they need a dark background. og_image is the homepage meta tag value exactly as served (http + legacy static1 path); it 301-redirects to a 200 and is the same file as the seared-scallops image listed below. NO PRESS IMAGES: I found a Diablo magazine Diablo Dish piece ('Seasonal Changes at Danville Harvest') but diablomag.com returned HTTP 429 (rate limited) when I tried to read it, so I could not verify any image on it; nothing was recorded from it. The restaurant's own site already carries three strong exterior corner shots, so no third-party exterior was needed.

images.description: Golden-hour three-quarter view of the corner building: the glassed-in wraparound porch with white-mullioned windows and a weathered wood frame, a large distressed metal sign reading 'harvest' in white lowercase mounted across the glass, purple market umbrellas and string lights above the shingled hip roof, a stucco knee-wall base, and a raised bed of blooming lavender and ornamental grasses along the sidewalk, with a big sycamore trunk framing the left edge. Site alt text: 'Danville Harvest Exterior'.

Wide dusk view of the whole restaurant from across Hartz Avenue: the pale-yellow Queen Anne cottage with its shingled hip roof and gabled porch, the glassed porch with the 'harvest' sign, navy market umbrellas over the side patio, string lights, an American flag on the corner post, a blue USPS collection box and a wine barrel on the far sidewalk, mature sycamores overhead, a brick-paver crosswalk in the foreground and the Las Trampas hills on the horizon. Site alt text: 'The view of Danville Harvest as seen from across the street.'

Blue-hour exterior of the same corner: the building lit warm from inside, the illuminated 'harvest' sign glowing on the glass porch, uplit lavender and grass plantings, navy umbrellas and string lights, a lit patio to the left, sycamores in silhouette against a deep blue sky, and the crosswalk and red-painted kerb in the foreground.

The side patio at night: a run of pale-yellow clapboard wall with tall white french doors glowing from inside, a white retractable awning, festoon lights and a row of infrared wall heaters overhead, wood-slat tables and chairs on the terrace, a weathered picket fence and ornamental grasses along the street edge, and deep blue dusk sky. Site alt text: 'The side patio area as seen at night.'

Back dining room: a grey button-tufted banquette against a herringbone reclaimed-wood feature wall hung with two round mirrors, sconces and small framed prints; tan leather nailhead chairs and a blue tufted booth, light wood tables with pink peonies in bud vases and rolled napkins, black dome pendant lamps, tall white-mullioned windows with floor-length linen curtains and a polished concrete floor. Site alt text: 'Our main dining area in the back of our restaurant. Great for private events.'

Front dining room with the full bar: a thick wood bar top with a steel rail running across the foreground, olive-green upholstered swivel stools, suspended steel-mesh glass racks over the bar, a caramel leather banquette along the back wall with wood tables, reclaimed barn-wood panelling, a small chandelier, pendant lamps, curtained windows and a hanging pothos. Site alt text: 'The view of our front dining area with full bar and tables.'

The bar shot straight down its length: a long polished wood bar top with olive-green swivel stools, a tiered back bar of whiskey and spirits under warm shelf lighting, suspended steel-mesh stemware racks, a wall-mounted screen, a small oak barrel, a brass tap and a service sink, glass-front wine and beverage coolers glowing blue under the counter, and a dark, moody overall key.

Long view down the dining room aisle: tan leather nailhead chairs at light wood tables set with pink peonies, folded grey napkins and cutlery; a white-tiled wall with a glazed pass-through shelf of stacked plates and glassware at left; black dome pendants; heavy linen curtains rope-tied to wood posts; blue tufted booths at right; polished concrete floor. Site alt text: 'Back Dining Area'.

Vertical/portrait interior: the dining room seen past a curtain and a glass partition, with black dome pendants in a row, linen curtains, a herringbone wood wall with round mirrors and sconces at the far end, a blue tufted booth at left and caramel leather chairs at set tables with pink peonies. Portrait orientation makes this useful for mobile or a tall card. Site alt text: 'Our back dining area. Perfect for private parties.'

Vertical interior: a row of tables with pink peonies in glass bud vases, rolled grey napkins and cutlery, tan leather nailhead chairs, black dome pendants, tied-back linen curtains and, over the far doorway, a large weathered sign reading 'COOK'. Shallow depth of field with warm light. This is the /events page og:image.

The homepage og:image: two golden seared scallops on a bed of risotto with a tomato-butter sauce and a tuft of red-veined micro-greens, in a dark speckled bowl on a weathered wood table, with a glass of white wine, a second plated fish course and stacked plates softly out of focus behind.

A glazed braised short rib set on a nest of wide pappardelle with wilted greens and topped with a tangle of crisp fried onion strings, in a dark speckled bowl on a weathered outdoor table, with a grapefruit-pink cocktail, jars of magenta and pink flowers and parked cars blurred behind. Site alt text: 'Glazed Short Ribs'.

A cheese and accompaniments board on a weathered wood table: a wood paddle with wedges of blue and hard cheeses, sliced green apple, dried apricots, spiced nuts, an olive, red onion, grilled crostini and a small steel pot of honey, beside a white plate of fried croquettes with a grapefruit and citrus salad, plus a pink cocktail and a teal ceramic plate.

A bone-in grilled pork chop topped with an apple-and-onion compote and jus, plated over sweet-potato puree and spinach on a rustic cream speckled-rim plate, on a wood table lit by window light, with a stemmed glass of beer and cutlery on a grey napkin softly out of focus behind. This is the /menu page og:image.
